Seamless file sharing and bidirectional clipboard sync between Android (Nothing OS), macOS, and iOS—without intermediate custom iOS apps.

Features:
• Bidirectional Clipboard Sync
• High-speed Wi-Fi P2P File Transfer
• Remote Cursor & Input Control
• Wireless Media Playback Remote
• Find My Phone (Alarm Ring)
• Remote macOS command triggers
An unofficial tribute to the design language of Nothing.
